title: Figentra Infrastructure Module Manifest
description: Validates every module.yaml in the infrastructure/modules/ registry. Each module declares a single infrastructure capability that deployables can opt into via their cloud.yaml modules[] array.

name.description: Kebab-case module identifier. Must match the parent folder name under infrastructure/modules/.

version.description: Semver version of this module contract. Breaking changes = major bump.

category.description: Capability family. Adding a new category requires an ADR amendment.

maturity.description: Lifecycle stage. Consumers of stable modules get semver guarantees.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what this module provisions.

consumes.description: Capability tokens this module requires from other modules.

terraform.description: Relative path to the Terraform reference file, or null.

docker.description: Relative path to the Docker Compose fragment, or null.

wrangler.description: Relative path to the Wrangler binding template, or null.

runtime_targets.description: Which runtime axes can provision this module.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the deployable config block in cloud.yaml modules[].config.

source.description: Source expression: terraform_output.X, module.config.Y, or literal.

env_vars.description: Environment variables this module contributes to the deployable runtime.
